reference: Approved ORAVA concept from this conversation; exact submitted prompt set

prompts.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily detailed WIDE PANORAMIC GAME LEVEL CONCEPT painting for 'ORAVA — ZVONČEKY NAD ORAVOU', based on the approved reference. Landscape ULTRAWIDE aspect ratio approximately 3:1, ideally 3072 by 1024. A SINGLE continuous horizontal side-scrolling game world across the entire width, NOT a four-panel poster and NOT separate screenshots. It represents a very long proposed level condensed for art direction. The camera is SIDE ON, so all playable foreground ledges are readable, with a primary middle route, a few higher roof/branch routes and secret lower alcoves. Rich smooth hand-painted HD cartoon platform art, deep atmospheric Slovak mountain landscape, crisp foreground moss, wood and stone; no pixel art, no 3D. No game implementation or HUD. NO CASTLES anywhere; no Orava Castle. Keep landmarks carefully recognizable.
Arrange EIGHT environments smoothly blending LEFT TO RIGHT, give each a small numbered wooden plaque along the top edge with only these short exact labels:
'1 MOST', '2 RIEKA', '3 KOŠIAR', '4 DREVENICE', '5 MÚZEUM', '6 KRÍŽ A CINTORÍNY', '7 PRIEHRADA', '8 STRÁŽCA'.
1 start at the iconic low wooden covered COLONNADE BRIDGE in Dolný Kubín, pitched shingle roof, timber posts, diagonal bracing, projecting roof kiosks and stone piers over blue-green River Orava. Foreground pathway crosses bridge deck with one modest 32-unit plank gap and visible lower rock alternative.
2 riverside with a small wooden waterwheel and two suspended log platforms, stones and flowing water, tiny safe cave behind waterfall BELOW bank.
3 grassy pasture, wooden sheepfold, shepherd hut and THREE fluffy white sheep individually placed on a meadow, low loft and fence terrace so they can be herded. A wooden sheep-emblem gate on the route, never hurt sheep.
4 steep-roofed dark log Orava houses, white chinking, flower windows; lower street and upper roof route, a hay cart platform, a visibly cracked cellar hatch under a barrel.
5 the open-air Museum of the Orava Village in Zuberec, historic log houses along a brook, small timber church with steep narrow shingle spire on a knoll. Three carved small plaques depict a sheep, fir and wave in separate ordinary accessible places, displayed as a little collection task.
6 peaceful cemeteries beside the museum and village, stone/wooden grave crosses and flowers behind fences, a LARGE WOODEN CRUCIFIX with a recognizable carved Jesus with arms on crossbeam and white loincloth, non-graphic and respectful. Safe walking path OUTSIDE graves, zero enemies here, no attack on religious items, no platforms on graves. A quiet lantern checkpoint beside the path. A hidden stone arch passage BELOW the external path, not through a burial.
7 vast Orava Reservoir behind the foreground route, low massive concrete dam and spillway, clearly flowing River Orava below it. Foreground maintenance canal with TWO hand wheels/sluice levers, one upper stable crossing, one lower temporarily exposed platform path. Only maintenance canal changes level, not the entire reservoir. Blue wave-emblem gate.
8 wide safe forest shoreline boss arena, a large round four-legged FOREST GREEN bear matching the Orava emblem from the reference: white muzzle, stylized white contour stripes on legs and shoulder, rounded ears, fir-tree motifs in fur, friendly formidable guardian, not a horned orange monster. Hero rings bells from left toward it, glowing golden stars, dog behind. The bear will be calmed, not killed. Exit decorated with green Orava crest of two firs/bear/waves; grand plate of bryndzové halušky at finish. Small secret high branch route beyond the arena.
Hero design from reference: little blond shepherd, huge soft dark brown hat, blue-white linen shirt, ochre trousers, leather shoes, TWO brass cowbells. Faithful cream floppy-eared dog with brass medallion. Show them only at start, one middle jump, and guardian scene so the scale remains readable and no clutter. Three mandatory collectible seal motifs: sheep at sheepfold, fir at museum, wave at dam. A few tiny pierogi and bacon pickups indicate optional paths. Include at least TEN naturally integrated discoverable secret nooks: under bridge pier, behind waterfall, barn hayloft, sheepfold buried cache, village cellar, roof chimney loft, under outer cemetery path, dam service room, dry canal recess, high forest branch. Secrets are hinted by cracks, one golden sparkle or dog paw marker; do not label them in large text. Clear route continuity, no impossible disconnected islands, readable walkable grass edge against backgrounds. Hero can jump ordinary small gaps. Let blue river and dark green forests tie the long level together. Main request is beautiful COMPLETE WIDE gameplay environment concept, not a tourist postcard.

Use case: stylized-concept / annotated level design. Create a highly legible professionally art-directed GAME LEVEL DESIGN CUTAWAY BOARD for the proposed ORAVA level in the reference, not an implemented game. Large landscape sheet approximately 3:2. It must show a complete LONG playable route and its tasks and secrets, not just decoration. Layout: two very wide horizontal map strips, top shows sectors 1–4 LEFT TO RIGHT; lower shows sectors 5–8 LEFT TO RIGHT. A discreet arrow at end of top strip points to start of lower. Each sector has three vertical route layers: clear bright solid gold MAIN ROUTE, dashed cool-blue UPPER/ALTERNATE ROUTE, dashed orange SECRET paths. Light cream parchment background, rich ink and smooth painted miniature side-on Orava environments, dark readable Slovak labels, spacious typography, no excessive microtext. A small three-item legend 'HLAVNÁ CESTA', 'ODBOČKA', 'TAJOMSTVO'. Title 'ORAVA · PLÁN LEVELU'. Subtitle '24 OBRAZOVIEK · 3 ÚLOHY · 10 TAJOMSTIEV'. Include FIVE clear lantern checkpoint symbols with 'C1' through 'C5'. Map is schematic gameplay space, not geographic cartography.
Top sectors:
1 'MOST' with Dolný Kubín's unmistakable long wooden covered pitched-roof colonnade bridge over the RIVER ORAVA, one missing plank gap, lower return ledge. Orange S1 below one stone pier. C1 at end.
2 'RIEKA' with waterwheel, two moving log platforms marked short back-and-forth arrows, stable upper bank alternative, orange S2 behind small waterfall, return tunnel to same river bank.
3 'KOŠIAR' with THREE visible sheep drawn at separate low places, arrows leading them to fenced pen via hero bell ringing. Quest label 'Ú1 · Priveď 3 ovečky'. Reward a carved SHEEP seal. Orange S3 hayloft and S4 buried cache beside fence. C2 after pen.
4 'DREVENICE' with traditional log houses, clear low street and high roof branch joined by a cart lift, orange S5 cellar under barrel and S6 chimney loft. Short ordinary jumps, no mandatory secret-route traversal.
Lower sectors:
5 'MÚZEUM' with Zuberec village museum log houses and stream, THREE carved collectibles on ordinary reachable ledges, quest label 'Ú2 · Vráť 3 rezby'. Reward a FIR seal. C3 after collection. Distant small timber church no castle.
6 'KRÍŽ A CINTORÍNY' with LARGE traditional wooden crucifix with respectfully carved non-graphic Jesus and two peaceful fenced cemeteries. Route stays outside graves; a quiet rest area, NO combat here, no destruction of sacred objects. Orange S7 arch below OUTSIDE path. C4 near the next section.
7 'PRIEHRADA' with wide lake and low concrete dam behind, two labeled hand wheels A and B controlling only a small foreground maintenance canal. Quest label 'Ú3 · A → B, otvor kanál'. Blue arrows show canal water lowered and lower ledges exposed, stable longer upper bypass remains open. Reward WAVE seal. Orange S8 service chamber and S9 dry canal niche.
8 'STRÁŽCA' with C5 before wide arena. Oversized friendly formidable four-legged GREEN BEAR based on reference emblem, white muzzle/contour legs, fir motifs. Hero and faithful cream dog at left, bells sending stars. Quest label 'Získaj 3 pečate · Upokoj strážcu'. Three tiny bear poses below arena illustrate attack telegraph, dodgeable ground wave, brief exposed bell-shaped weakness, not gore. Bear calms after 3 cycles. Orange S10 high branch AFTER guardian and short route back to finish. Exit crest contains sheep/fir/wave collected motifs plus actual ORAVA emblem. NO ORAVA CASTLE, no fortresses anywhere.
Small clean numeric ruler below each map strip: upper '0 — 3840', lower '3840 — 7680'. Forest and rock ledges visibly support the routes. Hero identity: blond shepherd, huge dark brown hat, white-blue shirt, ochre trousers, two brass cowbells. Small cream shaggy dog follows. Reference supplies art style, landmarks and green-bear design. Keep tasks numbered U1/U2/U3, secrets S1–S10 exactly once, and checkpoints C1–C5 exactly once. Emphasize a readable logical level plan with visible secret chambers and return loops, not an attractive but unplayable montage.
